summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. Woot API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights, data-flow evidence, privacy treatment, security controls, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete. Continue the existing read-only launch checklist; keep the permission request unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, or monetize returned data. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, with documented GSC permission failures; data quality is yellow for analytics and revenue attribution. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not claim certification, ROI, margin, causal lift, or site-attributed revenue.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, alert-data retention and workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked; missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures.

Continue containment-only execution. Incomplete telemetry is not a general growth blocker, but ordinary reversible work remains conditional on preserving consent, cookie and analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards. Do not create new tracking, monetization expansion, rights-dependent content, unsupported claims, public exposure, or external outreach.
